airship.name: Airship
airship.about: Moored at an airship mast: place it on the mast (same spot); it swings round the mast a little and bobs in the wind

airship_station.name: Airship station
airship_station.about: An airship station in the open: the mast with a lift, a canopy, a ticket kiosk. Tap it to fly; the airship moors at its mast (same spot)

variants.name: Portal: hole in the pavement (inner light, mockup)

city_sign_blank.name: City sign: logo spot, blank until S4 (mockup)

train_station.name: Skyline Station
train_station.about: Skyline Station (HB-7): the platform where runs start, its trains behind it (+y) on the rail, which runs out of its right end into sky_rail. Its act (station) comes from the map

sky_rail.name: Track
sky_rail.about: The track out of the station (cutscenes track A): 12 m pieces along x on a stone causeway, chained from the station's right-hand end; the last one (look end) has the buffer stop

sky_portal.name: Sky portal
sky_portal.about: The portal (cutscenes track A): floating on its own in the sky out to sea, its glowing layers stacked for depth and its rings turning; it faces its -y. The sky train rises off the track on its engines and shoots into it. Its gold look for the way home after a win

train_lakeland.name: Lakeland Clipper
train_lakeland.about: The Lakeland Clipper (HB-7), a sky train for its region theme (regions.json, its theme's train): it rides the sky rail on its skids, facing +x. HB-8: v 1 gold-trimmed (home from a won run), v 2 battered and smoking (a lost one)
